mathematics.assertion_tested: The retained leading QCD+QED Dashen group integral equals the independent SU2-axis/angle and disk-Bessel integrals on the grid. The first electromagnetic insertion is K=2(I2/I1)/z; mixed mass and metric derivatives agree, including K+zKprime=2rprime. Finite-t mass, charge and theta derivatives agree; chi=(m/2)per-flavor condensate survives for this retained operator. Large-mu charged-pair Gaussian comparisons are recorded without extrapolating the QCD regime.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Positive mu, nonnegative t=e4^2CV, real theta, SU2 normalized Haar; arbitrary precision numerical quadrature, analytic algebraic identities.
mathematics.conventions: Positive Euclidean aligned-vacuum-subtracted Dashen action t(a1^2+a2^2). Q=diag(2/3,-1/3); source e is written explicitly. Sigma,F,C held fixed in charge insertion. The unsubtracted constant exp(5t/9) and N(V,alpha) remain separate, not fitted. Derivatives of alpha act as t d_t only in this retained leading operator.
inputs: qed_inputs.json: 3mu x3theta x2t=18cases at80/110digits; 3mu insertion cases; 6saddle cases up to mu400.
non_claims: No physical alpha fit or alpha root
No independently calculated C, Sigma(alpha), F(alpha), higher electromagnetic LECs or dynamical photon determinant
The retained-action Ward identity is not an all-orders QCD+QED theorem
No fixed-positive-mass H->0 extrapolation of the epsilon regime
The constant-pion Gaussian comparison cannot be added twice to a full determinant
Numerical quadrature is checked by independent coordinates and increased precision, not certified intervals
